svg.title: Core tutorial: an AI agent retrieves API documents for a signed-in user
svg.desc: The IdP authenticates the human and returns the ID token to AI Client Gateway. The gateway obtains ID-JAG and an MCP access token from Athenz. Athenz ZTS mounts the Keycloak token exchange provider used by its IdP AS role. Runtime Proxy validates and exchanges that token, supplying a request-specific API token file to the MCP server. The API validates the API token and returns documents.

g.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
